# KJJ Tech

> KJJ Tech is an Orlando, Florida IT and UniFi networking company founded by Jorge Bello. We plan, install, secure and support UniFi networks (Wi-Fi, gateways, switches, UniFi Protect cameras, VPNs) for homes and small businesses: onsite around Orlando, and remotely anywhere in the U.S.

Contact: support@kjjtech.com, (914) 527-9957. Labor is $200/hour, or $340 for a 2-hour block and $750 for a 5-hour block. Onsite visits within 30 miles of Orlando start at a 2-hour block. Free 30-minute discovery calls and free network assessments are available.

## Services

- [UniFi installation in Orlando](https://kjjtech.com/unifi-installation-orlando.html): Wi-Fi access points, gateways, switches, VLANs and zone-based firewall setup
- [Security camera installation in Orlando](https://kjjtech.com/security-camera-installation-orlando.html): UniFi Protect cameras with local recording and no monthly cloud fees
- [Managed IT & network support](https://kjjtech.com/managed-it-support.html): proactive monitoring, updates, security reviews and a dedicated technician for small businesses
- [VPN & remote access setup](https://kjjtech.com/vpn-remote-access-setup.html): WireGuard, Teleport, site-to-site VPN and travel routers on UniFi
- [Remote UniFi services](https://kjjtech.com/remote-unifi-services.html): fixed-price remote UniFi configuration review ($340) and zone-based firewall setup ($750)
- [Orlando IT support](https://kjjtech.com/orlando-it-support.html): IT support for Orlando-area homes and businesses
- [IT support in Winter Park](https://kjjtech.com/it-support-winter-park.html)
- [IT support in Lake Mary](https://kjjtech.com/it-support-lake-mary.html)
- [Free network assessment](https://kjjtech.com/assessment.html)
- [Pricing](https://kjjtech.com/pricing.html)
